title: Claude Fable 5.2 review: fast, creative, and finally not annoying
text: Claude Fable 5.2 review: fast, creative, and finally not annoying Subscribe Sign in Playback speed × Share post Share post at current time Share from 0:00 0:00 / 6 1 Claude Fable 5.2 review: fast, creative, and finally not annoying 🎙️ My first-look at Fable 5.2: what it built for me, where it fell down, and whether it belongs in your daily AI stack Claire Vo Nov 09, 2026 6 1 Share Transcript Anthropic just released Fable 5.2, their new frontier model, and I spent two days actually building things with it before recording this. I made an animated marketing video from a single tweet, assembled a pile of unboxed furniture using only blurry floor photos, and extended our CXO brand sprites into a full bug-defense game complete with a trailer. In this episode I walk through what impressed me, what fell short, and how I’m thinking about routing tasks between Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 going forward. Listen or watch on YouTube , Spotify , or Apple Podcasts What you’ll learn: What Anthropic launched with Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, and when to reach for Fable instead of Opus 5.5 My pros and cons
